extracted.intended_audience: general readers of 19th-century travel literature; readers interested in descriptive accounts of the American West
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt of literary travel writing (descriptive narrative and anecdote) documenting impressions of water, lakes, prairies, towns, and encounters while traveling west in 19th-century America. The text is a first-person, reflective travelogue rather than an instructional or evaluative guideline.
